[binaries]
ar = 'arm64ec-w64-mingw32-ar'
c = 'arm64ec-w64-mingw32-gcc'
cpp = 'arm64ec-w64-mingw32-g++'
ld = 'arm64ec-w64-mingw32-ld'
windres = 'arm64ec-w64-mingw32-windres'
strip = 'llvm-strip'
widl = 'arm64ec-w64-mingw32-widl'
pkgconfig = 'aarch64-linux-gnu-pkg-config'

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true
c_args = ['-O2','-march=armv8.2-a','-mtune=cortex-x3','-fwrapv','-fno-strict-aliasing','-ffunction-sections','-fdata-sections','-fno-omit-frame-pointer']
cpp_args = ['-O2','-march=armv8.2-a','-mtune=cortex-x3','-fwrapv','-fno-strict-aliasing','-ffunction-sections','-fdata-sections','-fno-omit-frame-pointer']
link_args = ['-static','-static-libgcc','-static-libstdc++']
pkg_config_libdir = '/usr/lib/arm64ec-w64-mingw32/pkgconfig:/usr/share/pkgconfig'

[host_machine]
system = 'windows'
